gen-dafont-groovy-gf-orienta: Cord-like and cheerful: Groovy's curves carry the same weight as its stems, and its c nearly seals shut. Groovy grabs the eye, while Orienta lets its wide counters breathe.

gen-dafont-groovy-gf-parkinsans: Loosely tracked lowercase gives Groovy a friendly, funky stride, with only a narrow slit left in its c. Groovy handles the shouting, while wide-mouthed Parkinsans stays crisp when shrunk.

gen-dafont-groovy-gf-preahvihear: The text opens wide, like a pried oyster shell. Preahvihear lifts a lofty x-height through paragraph after paragraph without tiring, leaving Groovy and its marker-like line to handle the fun.

gen-dafont-groovy-gf-pt-sans-caption: Groovy is friendly, funky, and built from thin-looking letters with no thinner parts. PT Sans Caption brings unclosed, inviting bowls and big-bodied lowercase, which would carry text for pages without strain.
